title: American Eagle Sports Knife Lockback Folding Pocket Knife Gold Eagle Brass Box
categoryName: Collectibles:Knives, Swords & Blades:Collectible Folding Knives:Modern Folding Knives:Factory Manufactured
conditionDescription: Pre-owned. Blade has a small brown spot of residue/discoloration near the bolster (close-up pictured) and light scratches. Brass bolsters show light wear. Original box with shelf wear and plastic tray.
descriptionText:
American Eagle Sports Knife - lockback folding pocket knife in its original box with plastic display tray.

- Stainless steel clip-point blade etched "The American Eagle Knife", marked STAINLESS CHINA
- Black handle with raised gold-tone eagle inlay
- Brass bolsters

Condition: pre-owned. There is a small brown spot of residue/discoloration on the blade near the bolster (see close-up photos) and light surface scratches on the blade and brass. Box shows shelf wear.

Folding knife, not a switchblade or assisted opener. Buyer is responsible for knowing and following their local knife laws. Must be 18+ to purchase.

Ships padded in a box.
